manifest_row.title: Enormous iceberg breaks off from Antarctica

screening.main_topic: A giant iceberg breaking off the Larsen C ice shelf and the possible implications for ice-shelf stability and sea-level rise.
screening.climate_relevance: The report discusses Antarctic Peninsula warming, the relationship between ice-shelf collapse and glacier acceleration, and potential future sea-level rise. It also distinguishes this natural calving event from human-caused climate change.
screening.reason: Although the immediate event is a natural iceberg calving and the article says scientists are not linking it to human-caused climate change, climate-related warming, ice-shelf stability, and sea-level impacts are meaningfully discussed.
